Name: More Cows
Author: LotusLemon
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds three additional types of cows to Stardew Valley, each type producing something unique to its cow species. The types of cows are: [/color][/size]
[spoiler][list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Strawberry cow, which produced strawberry milk (normal sized and small).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Honey cow, which produces honey (wild honey without Extra Animal Config; flower honey with Extra Animal Config).[/color][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Space cow, which produces space milk ( (normal sized and small). This can be made into space cheese.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Ensure that you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed to run this mod. Extra Animal Config is an optional dependency which provides additional support for optional features. If you do not want these features, you can skip this dependency. However, if you play in multiplayer, ensure that everyone either does or does not have this dependency, as a mismatch will cause issues. Extract this mod into your Mods folder. Run the game using SMAPI.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI and Content Patcher are required for this mod. Extra Animal Config is recommended for this mod.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to my friends who helped me test out this mod![/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/zombifier?gameId=1303]Selph[/url] for helping me develop this mod by answering my modding questions and for making the Extra Animal Config mod, which allowed me to include my personal favorite feature in this mod. Thank you for the people in the Stardew Valley Discord modding channel for your various help and to everyone who helped create modding documentation, which I heavily relied on. [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]And of course, thank you Concerned Ape for making such a wonderful game![/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b][size=4]Other[/size][/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]There was no "AI" used in the making of this mod. [/size][/color]
